arms.G: lead + 1 GPU implementer (both qwen3.8-nothink via the router, scoped key)

layout: 3 x 128K chat with embed + rerank loaded (wf-window.sh open); restart timer, redteam watcher/idle, fast server, rag-refresh, swap webhook stopped
validity: runmeta.validity (same boot, router and chat invocations; 3-slot window open at both stamps) + harness run.json valid; nothing else invalidates a run. A T run with no probe samples is valid but fails clause 3

rule.quality: paired task bootstrap over 16 tasks x 4 runs, n_boot 10000, seed 20261007: lower95(T-G per-task acceptance) >= -1/16
rule.win: Welch 95% CI of T-G accepted tasks/hour (worker-accepted for T, implementer-accepted for G) excludes 0 (lo > 0)
rule.user: every valid T run's time-weighted user-lane probe p50 <= 1.5 x its window's idle baseline p50; failed probes count as 120 s
rule.gpu_time: chat-server ms per accepted task, per arm: REPORTED, not decisive
rule.clause2_confirmed_by_user: 2026-10-09: asked 'throughput decides (as drafted) or throughput-or-GPU-time?'; user answered 'go ahead and proceed with the testing' -> drafted rule (throughput decides)

void: tasks the transcript scan finds tainted, applied to every run of both arms (cli.py w3 --void)
probe: wf-user-probe.py in LXC 153, owner key, 60 s interval, no --until; 30-sample idle baseline per window
prior_observations_disclosed: W1: C2 0/30 loops, 87% pass, 98 s/attempt (CPU workers, no review)
arm-G pilot on gate T1/T2/T4: 3/3 accepted, GPU implementer looped 2/3 (repeat episodes until the 60-step cap)
